messages:
maya: quick note — partner proxy caused billing to attribute to proxy org not partner project. console vs billing mismatch. anyone seen this?
owen: yep, token exchange strips original origin claim so downstream attributes to proxy.
lee: could proxy attach an `x-origin` header? short-term observability.
kevin: header forgery risk. need authenticity for billing.
own: two paths: signed-origin claim or exchange-id -> origin mapping cached in routing layer.
sam: mapping avoids partner changes but adds cache dependency for quota decisions.
lee: console UX: add "Inferred origin (exchange-id)" column and a reconciliation delta widget.
maya: rollout idea: telemetry-only + sampling 2w, canary mapping for one partner region, pilot signed-claim later.
kevin: I'll add counters: `auth.exchange.lookup_hit/miss/latency` and `auth.reconcile.delta_pct`.
own: prototyping a memcache LRU + redis fallback, TTL=5m. will share latencies.
sam: canary plan: partner=P-42, region=us-west-2, sampling=10%, alerts if delta>3% or miss>2%.
auth-bot: deploy started svc-auth-exchange v3.2.0 -> canary us-west-2 (1/4).
maya: action items: kevin telemetry, owen cache prototype+flag, sam canary doc, lee console mock, maya rollout note. :thumbsup:
